key_terms: A consistent snapshot of operator state and source positions that Flink can restore after a failure.
A marker injected into the streams that separates records before and after a checkpoint, defining a consistent cut through the graph.
Buffering input from channels whose barrier already arrived until barriers reach every input, which can add latency under backpressure.
A source that can restore its read position from a checkpoint so records after that point are read again.
A sink that commits output only when a checkpoint completes, which is needed for end-to-end exactly-once results.
evidence: Project-only actual product commands with independent fixture oracles. Source preparation, native runtime observations and restart evidence are recorded separately in the workshop qualification ledger.
